failure_patterns.pattern: answer_format: The intended answer was identified, but the response used a noncanonical name, wrong number/article, or an unnecessarily expanded label.

rejected_edits.content: For definition clues, give the requested category term, not an example; match the part of speech and exact lexical form called for, including a derived or inflected form when requested rather than automatically reverting to a base lemma. Match grammatical number and necessary articles. If a clue points to two compounds or examples with a shared headword, return that shared headword rather than one full compound.
rejected_edits.target: For definition clues, give the requested category term rather than a list of examples, and match grammatical number and necessary articles.

rejected_edits.content: For personal and place names, follow the canonical form used in the clue or directly relevant evidence rather than automatically expanding or truncating it. Retain a jurisdictional qualifier when it is part of the supported place label, but do not add formal initials or suffixes to a concise personal-name form used in context. When a clue supplies part of a name and asks for completion, give only the missing component.
rejected_edits.target: Use a full canonical personal name when the clue does not supply a name component; when it supplies part of a name and asks for completion, give only the missing component.
